scope: Web interface and interaction design only. No renderer, operation contract, artifact format, prompt model, or target-support changes.
deployment: Not deployed. Reviewed production preview on port 3016; existing tailnet release remains unchanged.

method.visualReview: Root personally inspected native desktop/mobile gallery, Studio, drawers, picker, palettes, Explorations, and API reference screenshots. Rendering used the shared native-render lease.

direction.name: Indexed print workshop
principles: Let the artwork supply the visual complexity; use a quiet, ruled interface around it.
Charcoal grotesk type, monospace catalog labels, bone surfaces, and one oxide-red interaction accent.
Use square controls and explicit selected states instead of pill badges, generic gradients, glass, or a separate dashboard skin.
Keep document editing geometry and native 640px artwork independent of display layout.
direction.tokenNote: The established --teal custom-property name remains the shared accent hook; its value is now oxide red. No compatibility alias was added.

findings.issue: Palette secondary text had 4.39:1 contrast on the new paper surface.
findings.evidence: Initial axe scan of /palettes identified hard-coded #68746b text and module token overrides.
findings.resolution: Palette surfaces now use shared tokens. Muted/paper contrast is 5.45:1; accent/paper is 5.79:1. New default-palette functionality was preserved.

findings.issue: Scrollable source code could not receive keyboard focus.
findings.evidence: axe scrollable-region-focusable violation in the Field Marks source pre element.
findings.resolution: Source and operation example panes have focusable, labelled pre elements and visible focus outlines.

findings.issue: Mobile Studio drawers did not provide complete modal focus containment and background isolation.
findings.evidence: Baseline custom drawer source; surrounding app controls remained independently interactive.
findings.resolution: Modal semantics, background inertness, boundary Tab trapping, Escape behavior, opener focus return, and nested picker close behavior. Desktop panels remain non-modal.

findings.issue: Gallery navigation lacked a current-page state and bypass link; Studio reduced mobile links to 9px.
findings.evidence: Baseline SiteNav.tsx and Studio.module.css mobile nav override.
findings.resolution: One shared responsive navigation, current-page underline/aria-current, custom partition mark, and working skip-to-content targets.

findings.issue: Oversized gallery introduction delayed the artwork; long card descriptions and repeated Studio badges weakened scanning.
findings.evidence: .work/ui-design-audit/before-gallery-mobile.webp (original browser screenshot recovered from its capture artifact)
findings.resolution: Compact asymmetric introduction; numbered, image-led study index; concise card descriptions; complete descriptions retained in study pages. No artwork was substituted.

findings.issue: Small horizontal category strips concealed choices on narrow screens, and Color & raster/Raster & color split one browsing family.
findings.evidence: Baseline Gallery.tsx categories and mobile filter screenshot.
findings.resolution: Wrapping 44px desktop categories, native narrow-screen selects, shared display grouping in gallery/picker, pressed-state semantics, live counts, and clear-filter empty-state recovery. Catalog metadata is unchanged.

findings.issue: Gallery, Studio, palette library and prompt workspace used divergent fonts, colors, radii and control sizes.
findings.evidence: Baseline global and CSS-module tokens, 7-12px rounded widgets, and 9-11px Studio labels.
findings.resolution: Shared paper/ink/oxide system, square controls, readable helpers, larger interaction targets, limited motion and reduced-motion alternatives.

findings.issue: Tablet study controls competed with a small canvas; the desktop study frame stretched beyond its artwork; compact project actions risked clipping at narrow widths.
findings.resolution: Capped the desktop artwork track at 640px; stacked study layout below 850px; wrapping reference content; icon-labelled compact file actions; viewport-fitted Studio canvas. 320/390/768px route checks show no horizontal overflow.

findings.issue: Explorations had weak input/output hierarchy and an unhelpful empty preview.
findings.resolution: Visible prompt label and instructions, indexed brief/output panels, explicit start-new/follow-up actions, disabled-action explanation and status/error announcements. Existing execution and result retention semantics remain unchanged.

findings.issue: The API index required scanning the full operation list.
findings.resolution: Search by operation name, identifier or description; live result count and recoverable empty state. Only compact index metadata reaches the new client component.

findings.issue: Tabbed inspection and dialog focus needed a consistent interaction contract.
findings.resolution: Roving tab stops, labelled panels, arrow/Home/End navigation, native dialog initial focus and explicit focus return. Existing workspace checks now retain regression coverage for mobile modal boundaries.

verification.productionBuild: Passed, including TypeScript. Direct Next build intentionally avoided regenerating concurrent catalog work.
verification.workspace: Existing --workspace-only browser check passed: eight layers, twelve colors, independent scrolling, prompt persistence, mobile/short landscape, export focus, bounded picker.
smokeScenarios: Gallery search, empty-state recovery, combined raster category, all studies retained, keyboard skip link
Real control edit changes pixels; undo/redo restores exact pixels; arrow-key tabs retain prompt draft; PNG 640x640 and editable JSON downloads
Searchable picker, meaningful empty result, add layer and undo
320/390/768px route layouts, accessible mobile categories, modal drawer keyboard containment and Escape focus return, nested picker Escape preserves drawer
Palette draft remains unsaved; Explorations prompt enable/disable and contextual help
API search by identifier, empty-state recovery, and complete index restoration
Chromium synthesized touch moves artwork; undo restores exact baseline pixels

finalStudyFollowup.reason: Final visual review found excess blank space inside the desktop artwork frame.
finalStudyFollowup.productionBuild: Passed compilation and TypeScript after the 640px track correction.
finalStudyFollowup.nativeRendering: Captured through tools/with_native_render_lock.py; root inspected the saved screenshot.

verification.throwawaySmoke: Executed .work/ui-audit-smoke.mjs through the same lease; removed after evidence capture.

limits: No full WCAG certification or screen-reader/physical-device testing. Automated results cover the recorded surfaces and states, not every workflow.
Touch evidence is Chromium CDP synthesized touch, not a physical handset.
No new model generation or named project write was performed. Real canvas edits, undo/redo, source navigation, palette draft editing and downloads were exercised.
No full 90-study rerender matrix or cross-engine testing was repeated for this UI-only change.
Initial development-mode p5 imports stayed loading; the production build rendered normally. No renderer workaround was added.
Existing Next filesystem-tracing warning at lib/harness/jobs.ts:58 remains outside this UI scope.
Concurrent default-palette and operation changes are not admitted by this design review.
